scope: Controlled private-beta release envelope; this is not a claim of maximum platform capacity.

propertiesCovered: one-use admission token and absolute session expiry
founder role preservation and ordinary beta-tester assignment
no duplicate users or roles on replay
cross-user isolation and user-bound admission sessions
provider-capacity answer preservation and credit release
authenticationSessionAndDataSafety.note: Authentication and mutation safety use the passed production-faithful staging and Worker suites. Production capacity probes were intentionally read-only to protect genuine accounts and records.

safeOperatingEnvelope.basis: The user-facing envelope remains substantially below the 16-concurrent-request edge/database probe, the 60-connection database ceiling, and the provider's measured single-request safe lane. The Gemini lane, not static delivery or public database reads, is the binding capacity constraint.

pauseTriggers: any privacy or cross-user isolation defect
any lost draft or duplicate submission
provider capacity errors persisting for 15 minutes
grading p95 above 30 seconds for 15 minutes
rollbackAndEmergencyControls: disable PRIVATE_BETA_GATE_ENABLED to close new private-beta admission
roll back Worker traffic to the previously verified version
retain additive database structures during application rollback
stop grading expansion while preserving pending answers and releasing unconsumed attempts
decision: PASS for the documented controlled private-beta envelope; do not exceed it without a new measured capacity cycle.
